construction_secondary.role: Construction PPE, machinery and vehicle detection

hazard_auxiliary.role: Specialized hazard evidence; never accepted from one frame

excluded_models.models/candidates/prodbykosta_person_yol: Excluded after a real project sample was classified as horse instead of person.

safety_rules.helmet_safe: Require overlapping Helmet/Hardhat confirmation from BOTH PPE models and temporal confirmation in at least 3 of 5 inference frames.
safety_rules.vest_safe: Require overlapping Vest/Safety Vest confirmation from BOTH PPE models and temporal confirmation in at least 3 of 5 inference frames.
safety_rules.ppe_disagreement: Never mark SAFE when the PPE models disagree.
safety_rules.machinery: Use construction_secondary machinery/vehicle first; use auxiliary construction-machine only as a high-confidence fallback.
safety_rules.missing_ppe: Never infer missing PPE from a single absent positive detection. Prefer explicit negative class plus temporal evidence.
safety_rules.unsafe_behavior: fall_hazard, unsafe_ladder_use, phone-usage and no-fall-protection from the auxiliary real model require at least 3 positive observations in the last 5 inference frames.
safety_rules.auxiliary_false_positive_control: A single auxiliary-model hazard detection never creates a confirmed behavior incident.
safety_rules.distance: Worker-equipment distance is reported in pixels unless camera calibration/homography is configured; no uncalibrated meter claim is allowed.
